text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners & timelines for the customer-facing comms items: status page wording, 72h customer summary, and RCA-sharing policy. Proposed owners: @maria for status page, @sanjay for 72h summary, @elaine (legal) + @tom (comms) for RCA policy. Can everyone ack and confirm ETA or suggest changes? Also flag: recurring pattern of prefix-cache blowups shows up across last 3 incidents; we should call that out in comms and in ongoing mitigation items.

maria: Ack. I can take status page copy. I put a draft below — can ppl react with edits.

maria: ```
Incident: degraded inference throughput for select customers (prefix cache overflow)
Status: Resolved — full serving restored at 09:42 UTC
Impact: increased latencies and errors for a subset of requests between 07:18–09:42 UTC
What were doing: Investigating root cause and implementing safeguards to prevent cache pressure recurrence.
Next update: 72-hour summary and remediation plan due by Friday.
```

sanjay: Ack — Ill draft the 72h summary. Quick Q: for the 72h summary, do we include low-level logs/stack traces or keep it high-level? Need direction from legal/comms on redaction.

elaine: From legal: we should avoid raw logs or trace IDs in customer-facing docs. For enterprise customers with NDA/SLA clauses we can offer deeper artifacts under approved channels. For everyone else provide a redacted technical summary and timeline.

tom: +1 from comms. Proposed RCA-sharing policy blurb: "We provide a redacted incident RCA to all impacted customers within 72 hours. Enterprise customers may request the full RCA under existing contractual terms — contact your CSM for access." Thoughts?

alex: That blurb sounds good. @elaine, can you confirm the acceptable redaction level (e.g., remove PII, internal hostnames, raw traces)? If yes well roll with Toms wording.

elaine: Confirmed. Redact PII, internal hostnames, exact stack traces and session tokens. Include enough technical context for customers to understand severity and mitigation steps.

sanjay: OK will produce the 72h summary as redacted per above. ETA: Friday 18:00 UTC.

maria: ETA for status page final copy: EOD tomorrow (Ill post a final PR/link here once done). Suggest small tweak to status page wording to call out recurring prefix-cache pattern so customers know this is being tracked.

alex: Agree on calling out recurring pattern. Also action items for remediation owners:
- infra: add cache pressure alerts + automated eviction policy (owner: sanjay, ETA 2w)
- runtime: investigate KV cache sizing defaults (owner: rachel, ETA 1w)
- product: review query patterns that trigger long prefixes (owner: sarah, ETA 3w)
Please confirm or correct owners and add these to the incident action tracker.

sarah: Ill add product owner item to the tracker and link it here when done.

opsbot: Created task INC-4301: "Status page copy & 72h customer summary" assigned to maria/sanjay, due 2026-04-10. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4301

alex: Quick decisions summary:
- Status page final by EOD tomorrow (owner: maria)
- 72h redacted summary by Fri 18:00 UTC (owner: sanjay)
- RCA policy: redacted summary to all impacted customers; full RCAs available to enterprise customers under contract (owners: elaine/tom), decision noted.
- Remediation owners listed above; add to tracker and link tasks.

maria: Will post status page PR here in ~6 hours.

sanjay: Starting the 72h draft now; will ping for tech review once first pass is ready.

elaine: Ill prepare an internal blurb for CSMs describing what they can share with customers vs what requires legal approval.

tom: Will assemble the public-facing sentence and coordinate with marketing for any customer email copy if needed.

alex: Thanks all. Please mark items done in the tracker as you complete them. If any blockers, call them out here with "blocker:" prefix so we can triage quickly. :thumbsup:
